headline: Journal highlights dupilumab efficacy study in Chinese patients with persistent type 2 asthma
dek: Clinical & Experimental Allergy shared a new article on dupilumab in patients from China with persistent type 2 asthma, with and without an allergic phenotype.
body:
Clinical & Experimental Allergy, the official journal of the British Society for Allergy & Clinical Immunology, highlighted a research article on dupilumab in asthma in a post on X on 10 November 2026.

The article is titled "Efficacy of Dupilumab in Patients From China With Persistent Type 2 Asthma With and Without an Allergic Phenotype". Going by the title, it examines how effective dupilumab is in patients from China who have persistent type 2 asthma, including those with and without an allergic phenotype.

The post does not give any results, study design, patient numbers or author names. It carried the hashtags #Asthma, #AllergicAsthma and #Dupilumab, tagged the accounts @BSACI_Allergy, @EAACI_HQ and @APAAACI1, and included a link to the article.

Readers seeking the findings will need to consult the full paper through the link in the journal's post.
key_quote: Efficacy of Dupilumab in Patients From China With Persistent Type 2 Asthma With and Without an Allergic Phenotype
